result.summary: No overdue notifications are currently open for Aranya Pharma Packaging. The two prior overdue events (both reported by the same insurer, TCI) resolved quickly—7 days late in Feb 2026, improving to 3 days late in Jul 2026—with no signs of notifications piling up (1 per 6-month window, single policy). The sole credit line (INR 50M, 45-day terms) remains accepted and appears well supported by this payment behaviour, though the short history (only 2 events) limits confidence.
concerns: Only two resolved events on record, so the improving trend is based on limited history
Single insurer/policy reporting exposure—no cross-policy corroboration of buyer's payment habits
